intro: Samoa is a parliamentary democracy where only matai chiefs can stand for parliament.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The head of state is elected by parliament for five years. Laʻauli Leuatea Schmidt became prime minister after the 2025 election.

chapters.title: Village councils
text: Village councils of matai still make many local decisions.
